title: Gradient-Based Learning Applied to Document Recognition
summary: Yann LeCun, Leon Bottou, Yoshua Bengio, and Patrick Haffner published Gradient-Based Learning Applied to Document Recognition in Proceedings of the IEEE in 1998. The paper describes gradient-based learning for document recognition and presents convolutional neural-network systems including the LeNet-5 architecture for handwritten character recognition.
significance: A documented neural-network milestone in the late-1990s literature that records convolutional-network methods and the LeNet-5 system in an applied document-recognition context.
